units.titles: kols_list duplicate push issue | Oracle price decimal issue
units.known_address_notes: Report body references contracts/deploy/Vault.sol, CRPFactory.isCrp(pool) and CRPPool.getController(), i.e. a Balancer-v1 fork. The project's own deployed-contracts registry lists exactly the two Balancer-v1 artefacts (ConfigurableRightsPool, LiquidityPool) on Ethereum; both verified with matching compiler version. Repo contains no CRPFactory address, so the factory itself is the one gap.

units.titles: UniActionPolicy does not persist usages | ERC20SpendingLimitPolicy doesn't clear previous data
units.known_address_notes: Cantina Aug-2024 review covers the SmartSessions external-policy package (UniActionPolicy / ERC20SpendingLimitPolicy, both found via initializeWithMultiplexer). Both are ERC-7579 modules deployed at counterfactual addresses through the Rhinestone module registry, so the same address+code exists on every supported chain; verified UniActionPolicy on Base and bytecode on 1/8453/42161/10/137. Caveat: the live bytecode is the post-fix revision (audit findings were marked fixed).
